name: Talude Studio V1.2 — CLASSIFY LAS R20.4 + Crista/Pé

checks.name: Python 3.12
checks.hint: Instalar Python 3.12 e adicionar ao PATH.

test.name: Verificar fonte TALUDE + CLASSIFY LAS R20.4
test.command: $expected='TALUDE_STUDIO_CLASSIFY_LAS_R20_4_2026_10'; $p=Join-Path '%REPO%' 'localbuild/SOURCE_REVISION.txt'; if (!(Test-Path $p)) { throw ('SOURCE_REVISION em falta: ' + $p) }; $actual=(Get-Content $p -Raw).Trim(); if ($actual -ne $expected) { throw ('Fonte errada. Esperado ' + $expected + ', encontrado ' + $actual) }; Write-Output ('OK SOURCE: ' + $actual)

test.name: Instalar dependências Talude Studio
test.command: & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install --upgrade pip; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

test.name: Compilar motor + Studio
test.command: & '%PYTHON%' -m compileall -q ALGORITM src studio core tests talude_gui.py talude_studio.py

build.name: Verificar fonte TALUDE + CLASSIFY LAS R20.4
build.command: $expected='TALUDE_STUDIO_CLASSIFY_LAS_R20_4_2026_10'; $p=Join-Path '%REPO%' 'localbuild/SOURCE_REVISION.txt'; if (!(Test-Path $p)) { throw ('SOURCE_REVISION em falta: ' + $p) }; $actual=(Get-Content $p -Raw).Trim(); if ($actual -ne $expected) { throw ('Fonte errada. Esperado ' + $expected + ', encontrado ' + $actual) }; Write-Output ('OK SOURCE: ' + $actual)

build.name: Instalar dependências de build
build.command: & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install --upgrade pip; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

build.name: Validar motor e Studio antes do EXE
Criar Talude Studio Windows (paths absolutos)
build.command: & '%PYTHON%' -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean --windowed --noupx --name Talude_V1 --distpath '%WORK%/dist' --workpath '%WORK%/pyinstaller' --specpath '%WORK%' --paths '%REPO%' --paths '%REPO%/src' --hidden-import PySide6.QtWebEngineWidgets --hidden-import PySide6.QtWebEngineCore --hidden-import PySide6.QtWebChannel --hidden-import uvicorn.loops.asyncio --hidden-import uvicorn.protocols.http.h11_impl --hidden-import h11 --hidden-import laspy --hidden-import laspy.lasreader --hidden-import laspy.laswriter --hidden-import lazrs --collect-all uvicorn --collect-all h11 --collect-all fastapi --collect-all starlette --collect-all anyio --collect-all scipy --collect-all rasterio --hidden-import ezdxf --hidden-import pyproj --add-data '%REPO%/studio/viewer;studio/viewer' --add-data '%REPO%/studio/vendor;studio/vendor' '%REPO%/talude_studio.py'

build.name: Verificar Talude_V1.exe
build.command: if (!(Test-Path '%WORK%/dist/Talude_V1/Talude_V1.exe')) { throw 'Talude_V1.exe não foi gerado' }; Get-Item '%WORK%/dist/Talude_V1/Talude_V1.exe' | Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime

build.name: Self-test QtWebEngine + Potree + motor
build.command: Push-Location '%WORK%/dist/Talude_V1'; try { Remove-Item TALUDE_V1_SELF_TEST.txt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; & ./Talude_V1.exe --self-test; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; if (!(Test-Path './TALUDE_V1_SELF_TEST.txt')) { throw 'Self-test não criou relatório' }; Get-Content ./TALUDE_V1_SELF_TEST.txt } finally { Pop-Location }

build.name: Preparar Talude Studio portátil
build.command: $pkg='%WORK%/package'; if (Test-Path $pkg) { Remove-Item $pkg -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $pkg | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Recurse '%WORK%/dist/Talude_V1' ($pkg + '/Talude_V1'); Copy-Item -Force 'packaging/START_TALUDE_V1.bat' $pkg; Copy-Item -Force 'packaging/LEIA_ME.txt' $pkg; Copy-Item -Force 'README.md' $pkg
